question: What is Pinewood Insurance's contract notice deadline?

resolution.read_instruction: Extract any statement about Pinewood Insurance's contract notice deadline, including the notice period, the date by which notice must be given, renewal or termination dates, and any cancellation or non-renewal terms, quoting the relevant sentences.
assumptions: Question refers to the single call with Pinewood Insurance (CALL-012), a Renewal call.

findings.speaker: Leo Grant
findings.quote: Your current contract auto-renews with sixty days' notice, which means your notice deadline is the thirtieth of September.
findings.context: Pinewood's current contract auto-renews with sixty days' notice, so the notice deadline is 30 September. — Stated by OrbitFlow AE Leo Grant; Graham Attwood confirms he did not know and Nadia asks if he knew. Renewal date referenced as 29 November.

findings.speaker: Graham Attwood
findings.context: Customer acknowledges the notice deadline is three weeks away. — Customer reaction to the 30 September deadline.

findings.speaker: Graham Attwood
findings.context: Graham Attwood did not know about the notice deadline before the call. — Nadia asks whether he knew; he says no.

findings.speaker: Ruth Adeyemi
findings.quote: Your renewal's on the twenty-ninth of November.
findings.context: Renewal date is 29 November; the contract lapses on that date if not renewed. — Ruth states renewal date at start; Leo references lapse on 29 November.

findings.speaker: Leo Grant
findings.quote: Serve notice, which stops the auto-renew, and then we negotiate the six-month option separately without a clock on it.
findings.context: Serving notice by 30 September stops the auto-renew and costs nothing; the customer should do so to preserve options. — Vendor advice to serve notice regardless of the six-month decision.

draft.answer: Pinewood Insurance's notice deadline is 30 September, per OrbitFlow AE Leo Grant, under a contract with sixty days' notice that auto-renews [C1]. The renewal date is 29 November [C2]. Director of Operations Graham Attwood did not know about the deadline before the call and noted it is three weeks away [C3]. Leo advised serving notice by then to stop the auto-renew [C4].

claims.text: OrbitFlow AE Leo Grant stated that Pinewood's contract auto-renews with sixty days' notice, making the notice deadline 30 September.
The renewal date is 29 November (stated by CSM Ruth Adeyemi); the contract lapses on that date if not renewed.
Graham Attwood (Director of Operations) said he did not know about the notice deadline and reacted that it was 'Three weeks' away.
Leo Grant advised that serving notice by 30 September stops the auto-renew and costs nothing, so the six-month option can be negotiated separately without a clock on it.

not_covered: Whether Pinewood actually served notice after the call
The contract clause itself was not shown; the deadline comes only from the AE's statement
